instruction.reason: The debug interface, reset mechanics, fixed-step replay, and default-seed geometry are largely delivered, but a central requested flow is broken: different seeds produce the same course. The game's preserved presentation and keyboard start remain available.

spatial.reason: The initial 3D course is recognizable and coherent, but examining progression exposes a core course-generation defect: changing the deterministic seed does not change wall hole geometry. This materially undermines the purpose of the spatial course system.

interaction.reason: Fixed-step, mode switching, invalid-input rejection, and reset/replay sequences work reliably. Seed selection remains a local but requested failure, leaving the interaction rubric short of full compliance.

visual.reason: The retro neon title and 3D course establish a readable desktop identity, but oversized centered copy overlaps the scene and development-console text. The narrow layout cuts off the title and instructions instead of reflowing.

stability.reason: Desktop loading, reload, debug initialization, and repeated reset/step flows remain stable. The mobile presentation has a major responsive-layout failure, and the remote pose manifest timed out; the latter does not prevent the debug API from working.

note: Uncalibrated VLM preview; human scoring remains pending. Image delivery does not establish grading accuracy.
